description: Compact OpenAPI spec assembled from the official Postscript ReadMe endpoint pages listed in https://developers.postscript.io/llms.txt.

tools.name: compliance_redact
tools.description: Redacts subscriber data. When passed an email, phone number, Shopify customer ID, or Postscript subscriber ID, this endpoint also unsubscribes an active subscriber. Optional: email, phone_number, postscript_subscriber_id (plus 1 more). Returns the updated MessageResponse.

tools.name: compliance_unsubscribe
tools.description: Opts subscribers out of Postscript messaging. Optional: phone_number, postscript_subscriber_id. Returns the updated MessageResponse.

tools.name: events_create-custom
tools.description: Send a custom event to use in Postscript flows. Required: type. Optional: email, external_id, occurred_at (plus 3 more). Returns array of string.

params.name: occurred_at
params.description: UTC timestamp in Postscript's supported format: %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f.

params.name: type
params.description: Event type shown in Postscript flows.

tools.name: subscribers_get
tools.description: Get an individual subscriber for a shop. Required: id. Returns array of string.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID for the subscriber to get.

tools.name: subscribers_list
tools.description: Get a list of subscribers for a shop. Optional: page, sort, email__contains (plus 7 more). Returns array of Subscriber.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of results to start from.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting order in {field}__asc or {field}__desc format. Valid fields: created_at, updated_at, phone_number, shopify_customer_id.

params.name: shopify_customer_id__eq
params.description: Shopify customer id is equal to.

params.name: ps_id__eq
params.description: Filters subscribers by their ps_id tracking ID.

params.name: created_at__gte
params.description: Created at is greater than or equal to.

params.name: updated_at__gte
params.description: Updated at is greater than or equal to.

tools.name: subscribers_update
tools.description: Updates data for a given subscriber. Required: id. Optional: email, properties, tags. Returns array of string.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the subscriber to update.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to add to the subscriber.
